headline: Executive order sets up the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, a group that advises the President.
what_it_does: This order deals with the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, an advisory group that gives the President advice on science and technology issues. No summary was provided, so the specific details of the council's makeup and duties are not described here. Advisory councils like this make recommendations but do not themselves create new rules for the public.

who_it_affects.group: Scientists, engineers, and technology experts outside the government
who_it_affects.how: Some may be chosen to serve on the council and give advice to the President.

who_it_affects.group: White House and federal science policy staff
who_it_affects.how: They may work with the council and receive its advice on science and technology matters.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 22, 2019; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
